risk_note: RV2 (packages/money). Two display formatters plus a range helper for BR-TEXT-10 (App form and admin form with two decimals and thousands separators), pure bigint, no Intl / toLocaleString / number; error classes moved to src/errors.ts to break an import cycle, exports unchanged. Rule tests and NotImplemented skeleton by Codex (spec_commit), container red run on the spec_commit tree; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent. Ledger refs are empty because the brief with BR-TEXT-10 exceeds 24KB; the orchestrator excerpted BR-TEXT-10 into the brief and reviews were read from their raw output. Written by hand.

reviews.scope: independent read-only Claude subagent (money prompt): pass, no findings; seven-item checklist rounding / sign ok, others n/a

spec_test_review.note: rule tests by Codex reviewed by a fresh Claude subagent: pass with one S2 (thousands grouping must not depend on locale), passed on to the implementer

longrun.note: test/properties is unchanged from main (same tree); this PR's CI longrun-props reruns it at PROP_RUNS=1000000 because the packages/money tree changed. The new display property test lives in test/spec and runs in pnpm verify.
